title: Parameter Extraction Pipeline — Build 8 Extractor Scripts
description: Build the data-driven extraction pipeline that reads hyperMILL installation files (Metric.cfg, omCycles.txt, demo.db, IM_Tool_DB, IM_Macro_DB, omFeature2JobCatalog XMLs, omPP XMLs) and outputs structured parameter schemas. These schemas are the foundation for all subsequent KC milestones — every skill, script, hook, and physics mapping is auto-generated from them. 8 extraction scripts covering the full ~8,163 parameter surface.

forge_triple.hook: parameterExtractionValidator — BUILT — validates extracted schema completeness
forge_triple.action: extract_hypermill_parameters — BUILT — triggers full extraction pipeline

sessions.title: Core Extraction Scripts — Metric.cfg + omCycles + demo.db
knowledge: data/hypermill/Metric.cfg (138 files with cycle parameter defaults)
data/hypermill/demo.db (SQLite: 547 tools, 29 geometry classes, 2706 cutting techs)
sessions.intent: Build 4 extraction scripts that parse Metric.cfg directory into cycle parameter schemas, parse omCycles.txt into cycle-to-parameter mappings, extract demo.db tool geometry and cutting technology schemas, and produce unified JSON schema output for each parameter.

units.title: MetricCfgExtractor — Parse 138 Metric.cfg files into cycle parameter schemas
units.description: Script that walks the Metric.cfg directory tree, parses each .cfg file (INI-like format with cycle parameter defaults per controller variant), and outputs a JSON schema per cycle type with field name, type, default value, range, and unit. Covers ~6,240 CAM cycle parameters across all variants.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Script parses all 138 Metric.cfg files without error
Output JSON contains parameter name, type, default, min/max range for each field
At least 6,000 unique parameters extracted across all cycle types
Unit tests verify parsing of 3 representative .cfg files with known parameter counts

units.title: OmCyclesExtractor — Parse omCycles.txt into cycle-to-parameter mapping
units.description: Script that parses omCycles.txt (cycle type enumeration with parameter list per cycle), producing a mapping of cycle_type → [parameter_names] with metadata (required/optional, parameter group). Cross-references with Metric.cfg output to validate completeness.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: All 120+ cycle types parsed from omCycles.txt
Each cycle type has complete parameter list with required/optional flags
Cross-validation against Metric.cfg schemas shows >= 95% parameter coverage
Unit tests verify 5 representative cycle types match expected parameter counts

units.title: DemoDbExtractor — Extract tool geometry + cutting tech schemas from demo.db
units.description: Script that opens demo.db (SQLite), extracts 29 geometry class schemas with all fields (diameter, length, flutes, corner_radius, etc.) and 2,706 cutting technology parameter sets. Outputs JSON schemas for tool parameters and cutting technology parameters.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: All 29 tool geometry classes extracted with complete field lists
At least 2,500 cutting technology entries extracted with parameter schemas
Output schema includes field type, range, unit, and nullable flag
Unit tests verify 3 geometry classes (endmill, ballnose, drill) match known field counts

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ 3 extraction scripts produce valid JSON schemas | ✓ >= 6,000 CAM params + 29 geometry classes extracted | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Extended Extraction Scripts — IM_Tool_DB + IM_Macro_DB + XML + Post + Schema Unifier
sessions.intent: Build 5 more extraction scripts covering IM_Tool_DB, IM_Macro_DB, feature-to-job XMLs, post-processor config XMLs, and a schema unifier that merges all extracted schemas into a canonical parameter catalog.

units.title: IMToolDbExtractor + IMMacroDbExtractor — Cutting tech and macro schemas
units.description: Two extraction scripts: (1) IM_Tool_DB extractor for cutting technology parameters (speeds, feeds, depth-of-cut per material-tool combination), (2) IM_Macro_DB extractor for feature macro parameter schemas (drilling macros, pocket macros with all configurable fields).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: IM_Tool_DB extraction produces cutting tech schemas for all tool-material combinations
IM_Macro_DB extraction produces macro parameter schemas with field types and defaults
Combined output adds >= 500 new unique parameters not covered by Metric.cfg
Unit tests validate 3 representative entries from each database

units.title: XMLExtractors — Feature2Job catalog + PostProcessor config schemas
units.description: Two extraction scripts: (1) omFeature2JobCatalog XML parser that extracts feature-to-job parameter mappings (which cycle parameters are available per feature type), (2) omPP XML parser that extracts post-processor configuration parameter surface (controller-specific output options).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Feature2Job parser extracts all feature-to-cycle mappings from XML catalog files
PostProcessor parser extracts configuration parameters for all post variants
Combined output covers fixture/setup and NC output parameter domains
Unit tests verify XML parsing on 2 representative files per type

units.title: SchemaUnifier — Merge all extracted schemas into canonical parameter catalog
units.description: Unifier engine that takes output from all 7 extraction scripts, deduplicates parameters, resolves naming conflicts, assigns canonical IDs (HM-P-XXXX), groups by domain (CAD/Fixture/CAM-Core/CAM-Advanced/Linking/Simulation/NC/Settings), and produces the master HyperMillParameterCatalog JSON used by all subsequent KC milestones.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Master catalog contains >= 7,500 unique parameters with canonical IDs
Each parameter has: id, name, domain, type, range, default, unit, source_file
Domain distribution roughly matches expected: CAD ~275, Fixture ~200, CAM-Core ~2500, CAM-Advanced ~1500, Linking ~960, Sim ~500, Settings ~265
Zero duplicate parameter IDs in merged output

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ 8 extraction scripts complete | ✓ master catalog >= 7,500 params | ✓ all domains covered | omega_floor >= 0.90
